verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Honeybadger offers a "Describe your search" panel that turns a natural-language description into an error search query (docs-5). It also offers anomaly detection that compares error volume to a learned baseline and surfaces statistical insights such as "4.7× your normal rate" (docs-9). The MCP server only exposes data to external AI assistants, so it is not in-product insight and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit in-product AI-generated summaries or root-cause insights, AI suggestions or fixes for errors, clear documentation that the search panel is LLM-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
